title: A family archive of voices
description: Collecting recordings of the people close to you with names and dates that make sense, and exporting them in a format you can actually listen to.

blocks.text: A family collects recordings of the people close to them and labels the person, the date and the circumstances. A short description makes it possible years later to tell which is a greeting, a conversation or a story, without playing every file.

quote.text: Used this app to preserve my beloved Mother’s voice from an answering machine after she had passed. Precious and priceless opportunity to hear her voice whenever I need to do so.

blocks.text: A voice you can find again

The important first path is to add an existing recording, name it and export a copy you can play the ordinary way. A transcript can make searching easier, but it must not stand in for the voice itself.

There is no need here to build yet another voice recorder with meeting processing. The value lies in organizing and preserving personal material; it has to be tested on a small family archive, including the ability to take it away in one piece.
